name: Moon Lights the Sky, Spring Blossoms High
description:
A Lantern Rite keepsake crafted by the Ministry of Civil Affairs. The Ministry had originally intended to offer only Xiao Lanterns as souvenirs, but after receiving waves of heartfelt suggestions, they decided to include many more festive decorations. Though the Lantern Rite is fleeting,
the Xiao Lanterns and the virtues they carry continue to illuminate the streets and alleys.
